title: Roguelite Reward Choice Screen UI Mock
summary: A full-screen UI mock of the classic roguelite reward screen: three upgrade cards with icons, rarity colours and short effect text over dimmed gameplay, plus reroll and skip buttons, currency, run progress and a persistent HUD. Slots for theme, UI style and the three upgrades.
prompt:
A full-screen 1920x1080 UI mock of a roguelite reward choice screen, as it would appear in the shipped game. The run is paused and the gameplay behind is dimmed and slightly blurred.

Game theme: {argument name="theme" default="a neon arcade underworld where the hero fights through cursed pinball machines"}.
UI style: {argument name="ui_style" default="bold flat shapes, thick dark outlines, chunky rounded corners and a slight retro arcade glow"}.

# Centre: choose one of three
- Title across the top centre: "{argument name="screen_title" default="Choose a Boon"}".
- Three vertical upgrade cards side by side, equal size, evenly spaced, the middle one slightly raised as the hovered selection with a glowing outline.
- Each card: a large central icon, the upgrade name, a rarity strip in its rarity colour, and one or two short lines of effect text with numbers highlighted.
- Cards: {argument name="upgrades" default="1) Multiball - common - Your attacks split into 2 smaller projectiles. 2) Tilt Shock - rare - Dashing releases a shockwave for 12 damage. 3) Jackpot Heart - epic - Heal 5 HP every 10 coins collected."}.
- Rarity colours: common grey-white, rare blue, epic purple, legendary gold.

# Bottom bar
- Reroll button with a small cost and a skip button, both clearly labelled, with keyboard and gamepad-neutral styling (no platform button glyphs).

# Persistent HUD (dimmed but visible)
- Top-left: health bar with numbers and current build icons in a small row.
- Top-right: currency counter and a run map strip showing the current room among the next few nodes.

# Readability
- High contrast text on solid panels; a single UI typeface family with a bold display weight for titles.
- Everything inside a 5% safe area; the three cards are the clear focal point.
- Palette: {argument name="palette" default="hot magenta and electric cyan accents on deep purple-black panels"}.

# Avoid
Misspelled or gibberish text, more than two lines per card, overlapping panels, tiny unreadable labels, real console button icons, real game logos, watermarks.
